paragraphs.text: Readers remember slightly less from a screen than from paper when the text is long and the reading is done under time pressure. With short texts the difference disappears.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One explanation is the shape of the page. On paper the reader knows where a passage sits — halfway down the left page — and this memory of place helps recall; scrolling removes it.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Habits matter too. People scroll faster than they turn pages and check other windows while reading, and both raise the chance of missing a sentence.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Publishers have responded with screens that show a fixed page and a progress bar instead of endless scroll, and early tests show that recall improves a little.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Readers remember slightly less from a screen than from paper

explanation.en: What the studies found: slightly less is remembered from a screen → i.
explanation.kk: Зерттеу нәтижесі: экраннан сәл азырақ есте қалады → i.
explanation.ru: Результат исследований: с экрана запоминается чуть меньше → i.

items.quote: One explanation is the shape of the page.

explanation.en: The shape of the page and the memory of place → ii.
explanation.kk: Беттің пішіні және мәтін орнының есте сақталуы → ii.
explanation.ru: Форма страницы и память о месте текста → ii.

explanation.en: Behaviour: faster scrolling and other windows → iii.
explanation.kk: Мінез-құлық: жылдам айналдырады, терезелерге алаңдайды → iii.
explanation.ru: Поведение: быстрее листают, отвлекаются на окна → iii.

items.quote: screens that show a fixed page and a progress bar

explanation.en: Publishers changed the design to a fixed page → iv.
explanation.kk: Баспалар дизайнды өзгертеді: тұрақты бет → iv.
explanation.ru: Издатели меняют дизайн: фиксированная страница → iv.
